description: This file defines a Java enum 'TestContext' that manages thread-local test context data within a testing support package for the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: TestContext
classes.description: An enum singleton that provides thread-local storage for test context data, allowing getting, setting, and resetting context variables.

methods.name: get(String name)
methods.description: Retrieves an object stored in the test context map by its name.

methods.name: get()
methods.description: Returns the entire thread-local test context map.

methods.name: set(String name, T object)
methods.description: Stores an object in the test context map under a specified name.

methods.name: reset()
methods.description: Clears all entries in the current thread's test context.
